handoff.summary: The completed explicit PARI/Hecke literal-generator witness boundary now has an explicit v3 conditional-GRH/unconditional request option. Every unconditional iteration requires full PARI bnfcertify(b,0)==1 or both Hecke public GRH=false proof owners, with execution records joined through CLI, wire, receipts, validators, normalization and scalar pairing. Historical v1/v2 receipts retain conditional meaning; PARI regulator stays approximate and both engines retain only the final batch result. Fresh offline receipts pass 56 runner tests (14 new policy groups), 20 persistent tests, four direct Node tests with GP skipped, and strict Python (389 modules). Coordinator has reviewed the source and authorized the exact separately capped local fixture commands only after commit/push; no new CAS diagnostic has run at this source checkpoint. Existing pinned 2.15.4 compatibility evidence applies to earlier source 3600649e4 and is publicly linked in PR237 comment 5644853672. Full platform/build and M0 qualification remain draft.

Historical native-text/v1 timings do not measure the strengthened explicit output or new proof work. PARI regulator is not an enclosure; neither worker retains all batch outputs.
